rules.title: Prohibition on Blanket Criminal Bans and Arrest-Only Inquiries
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from using blanket bans on applicants with a criminal record and from considering arrests that did not lead to convictions.

coverage.summary: Applies broadly to residential tenancies in California under state fair housing regulations.

rules.quoted_span: Blanket bans on applicants with a criminal record are prohibited, as are policies that consider arrests without convictions.

rules.title: Mandatory Acceptance of Section 8 and Government Housing Vouchers
rules.requirement: Landlords are prohibited from refusing to participate in government housing subsidy programs, such as Section 8, effectively banning 'No Section 8' policies.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential properties under the Fair Employment and Housing Act definition of source of income.

rules.quoted_span: state law prohibits landlords from refusing to participate in such programs.

rules.title: Alternative Credit Evidence Option for Government Subsidy Holders
rules.requirement: Rental property owners are prohibited from using an applicant's credit history as part of the application process if they have a government rental subsidy, unless they first offer the applicant the option to provide alternative evidence of a verifiable legal means to pay their portion of the rent.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental applicants utilizing government rental subsidies such as Section 8.

rules.quoted_span: amended FEHA to prohibit rental property owners from using a person’s credit history as part of the application process – if they have a government rental subsidy, such as Section 8 — without offering the applicant the option to provide alternative evidence of a verifiable legal means to pay their portion of the rent.
